items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I guess, what it most sounds like is probably like Elton Bonner. But it's not that he's my favorite piano player. It's just that I think it fits in good with the band I play.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, the Swedish women I've heard about. Yeah, yeah. It's a great American mythology. But no, seriously, what style do you characterize your band as? Do you have any particular influences? Yeah.

When we started playing, the musicians were in a very different style, all of them. But after a while, it sounded similar to a Bunk Johnson band, I would say. And now later, it changed a little. But Kleiner played, he played more like Bonner's style, you know. He used to play more like Lewis. It changed a little more. We played, we kind of played that style with very few solos. We didn't even play piano over the door in the beginning. And we had the drummer, he played strictly Baby Don's style. Just getting that.…
